text: MECHANICAL FIXTURE ONLY: official C136657; programmer power integration unqualified.

C1/C2: VDD/VDDA; C3: VREF+; C4: VBAT; C5: NRST

Unused GPIO: firmware analog mode. HSI48/CRS for USB; no external crystal.
AS5600, 3.3 V, I2C address 0x36 - optional assembly population
PGO retains internal pull-up; OUT unused. Volatile settings only; OTP programming excluded.
DIR=GND: clockwise viewed per datasheet. Motor-side orientation must be calibrated.
BOTTOM AS5600 centered on Phidgets 3323_0 rear shaft; assembly tolerance qualification pending.
FDCAN2 in classical CAN mode, up to 1 Mbps; no CAN FD data phase
RS grounded selects high-speed mode. VREF unused.
DRAFT: external connector, bus ESD and selectable 120 ohm termination still pending.
AP63203 fixed 3.3 V; input requires upstream inrush and reverse-current protection
C8/C9: 50 V; C10: 100 nF / 50 V bootstrap; C11/C12: 22 uF / 25 V nominal each
0.3 A logic budget proposed; effective capacitance, startup, ripple and thermal tests pending
DO NOT connect the 10 uF buck input directly to USB-C: protected power path unfinished
VM power switch, regenerative-energy clamp and motor connector pending; no 5 V motor operation
180 mOhm / 1 W sense pair: nominal full scale 1.149 A RMS; proposed firmware cap 1.0 A, bring-up 0.3 A
200 uF / 35 V bulk nominal; capacitor ripple, polarity, startup and thermal qualification pending
DRAFT: protected output NOT yet connected to buck or motor; inrush/reverse blocking pending
Initialize UCPD sink Rd BEFORE raising PB12/DB. PA9/PA10 grounded; motor ENN remains pulled high.
OVP static screen: 22.51 V nominal; narrow transient margin still BLOCKS protection qualification.
D_VBUS is input surge protection, NOT a motor brake. USB data: direct FS PHY, 90-ohm routing pending.
